task: Remove a deprecated field from the public API response. Token budget is critically constrained.

candidate_memories.content: Public API fields cannot be removed without a 90-day deprecation period and a major version bump. Removing a field before the deprecation window closes is a breaking change and violates the API compatibility contract; it will immediately break consumer integrations.
Add a deprecation notice to the API changelog with the planned removal date.
Breaking changes must be announced in the API newsletter at least 60 days in advance.
